description:
\***\*About the Role\*\***  
  
Uber's applications are a critical part of daily life for hundreds of millions of users globally. Ensuring a seamless, stable, and high-performance experience across a diverse range of devices, OEMs, Android versions, and network conditions is a monumental challenge. This is where the Mobile Observability team comes in. We build the foundational Android SDKs that provide deep, real-time insight into the health of all Uber applications (Rides, Eats, Freight, and more). Our mission is to proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve critical issues like crashes (JVM and native), ANRs, out-of-memory errors, memory leaks, jank, and performance bottlenecks before they impact our users. You will help engineer the lightweight, highly efficient observability tools that are embedded within every Uber Android app. These SDKs are the "flight recorder" for our mobile fleet, capturing the diagnostic data needed to identify and fix the most complex bugs that happen in production. If you enjoy solving low-level problems, like debugging hard issues, and want to build tools that directly improve stability for hundreds of millions of users, this is the team for you.  
  
**\*\*What You'll Do\*\***  

* Design, develop, and maintain components of the core Android observability SDKs for crash reporting, ANR detection, performance monitoring, and bug diagnostics.
* Write performant, low-overhead code. Our SDKs run in the critical path of every Uber app and must have minimal impact on startup time, runtime performance, battery life, and app size.
* Investigate crashes, ANRs, memory issues, and performance bugs from across Uber's Android apps, perform root cause analysis, and implement platform-level fixes.
* Build tooling and heuristics to automatically detect and classify bugs, from UI glitches to multi-threaded race conditions.
* Detect and diagnose OEM-specific and Android-version-specific issues across the device landscape.

### **Description & Requirements**

**About the Role**

  

The SBU Connectivity Product Management Lead is the portfolio-level owner for product management, product evolution, go-to-market orchestration, and lifecycle value realization across SBU Connectivity. The role consolidates the former product-specific Business Lead responsibilities into one Product Management organization while maintaining distinct product lines for telematics and connectivity offerings and clear interfaces with the Global Business Lead for overall commercial/business ownership.

  

You will translate market, customer, technology, and RFQ signals into a coherent portfolio roadmap, investment priorities, differentiated product propositions, and executable business cases. Drive a product-first operating model that increases reuse, reduces bespoke development, improves R&D return, and strengthens global market adoption through close partnership with NPI, Systems/Solution Architecture, Product Engineering, Global RFQ/Early Engagement, Global Delivery, Finance, Sales, and the Global Business Lead.

  

You will lead a globally distributed team of product managers and regional GTM product managers and influences a broad matrix spanning engineering, architecture, delivery, finance, sales, marketing, and customer teams. Success requires enterprise-level judgment across multiple product lines, regions, customers, investment horizons, and technology generations.

Manage the global Product Management organization spanning telematics/connectivity product lines and regional GTM product management in the Americas, Europe, Japan, India/APAC and other priority markets. You

  
  

will build a strong product management discipline with common methods for roadmaps, business cases, product requirements, lifecycle governance, GTM readiness and portfolio decision making.

  

**What You Will Do**

* **Own Portfolio Product Management**: Drive product evolution, 3–5-year roadmaps and lifecycle decisions across Connectivity, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and profitability.
* **Lead GTM & Regional Product Management**: Convert market and Voice-of-Customer signals into product priorities, positioning, value propositions, sales enablement and launch readiness.
* **Partner for Growth**: Work with Global Business Lead, Sales and RFQ/Early Engagement to shape opportunities around scalable products and derivatives rather than bespoke solutions.
* **Own Product Business Cases & Value Realization**: Establish product investment logic across market potential, pricing, revenue, margin, R&D, lifecycle cost, reuse and ROI in partnership with Finance.
* **Manage Product Performance**: Track adoption, pipeline fit, reuse, financial contribution, roadmap execution and customer feedback, taking corrective action when expected value is not realized.
* **Connect NPI to Product Ownership**: Partner with NPI to mature new concepts and technology opportunities into validated product propositions with disciplined transition into portfolio ownership.
* **Drive Cross-Functional Product Realization**: Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Global Delivery to translate market needs into scalable platforms, executable roadmaps and reusable production-ready releases.
* **Establish Product Management Excellence**: Standardize MRD/PRD, roadmap, business case, launch, lifecycle and decision frameworks while resolving cross-product priorities at portfolio level.
* **Build Global Product Leadership**: Develop a high-performing global Product Management and GTM organization with strong accountability, a customer-centric, data-driven, product-first culture.
  

**What You Need to Be Successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field; advanced technical or business degree preferred.
* 20+ years of progressive experience in automotive, connectivity, technology or adjacent industries, including significant leadership responsibility across product management, business development, GTM and product commercialization.
* 10+ years leading senior, globally distributed teams and complex matrix organizations across multiple regions, customers and product lines.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-product roadmaps, product lifecycle decisions, business cases, pricing/value propositions, investment prioritization and go-to-market execution.
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to balance revenue, margin, R&D investment, product reuse, time-to-market and long-term portfolio value.
* Broad understanding of automotive connectivity and telematics technologies including cellular/5G, V2X, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/GNSS, cloud/edge services, cybersecurity, OTA and automotive-grade hardware/software platforms.
* Proven ability to convert customer and market needs into differentiated, scalable product propositions while resisting unnecessary bespoke complexity.
* Executive communication and influencing skills with credibility across customers, senior leadership, engineering, sales, finance, partners and globally distributed teams.
* Ability to make high-quality decisions under ambiguity and lead transformation across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct authority.
  

  

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* MBA or advanced degree paired with a technical undergraduate degree.
* Experience leading telematics/connectivity portfolios spanning mobility segments.
* Experience with ecosystem partnerships, new business models, software/services monetization and global OEM commercialization.
  

  

**What Makes You Eligible**

* You are willing to travel up to 30% domestic and 15% international travel.

* Due to the nature of global teams and customer base, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required.

* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence

**What You’ll Be Part Of**

In this role you will be responsible for driving the Software Factory strategy and culture across all of Harman Automotive to continuously improve the Software engineering. In brief, A Software Factory is an integrated set of tooling, services, data, and processes that enables engineers to plan, build, test, adaptively release, and/or operate and manage the software. You will lead a team of delivery experts to transform the engineering organization into a cloud based design, development and test factory. This role will work with the SBU product and project teams to utilize and implement a Software Factory approach, with a high degree of mastery and consistency. This team will also be responsible for looking externally to the industry to evaluate best practices for modern software development and delivery, of state-of-the-art technology products.

**Your Team**: This leader will be responsible for a team of 8 direct reports.

  
  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Evaluate industry operating model benchmarks and collaborate with SBU Engineering Excellence and technology leaders for defining implementation roadmaps.
* Lead a cross functional team of engineers, architects, and technology leaders with expertise in building cloud-based software design, development, simulation, and testing methods.
* Challenge, motivate, support, and hold accountable SBU product and project teams to adapt new operating model initiatives (processes, tools, capabilities).
* Partner with SBU engineering excellence, delivery, and domain leadership to define a shared enterprise level software engineering strategy, test methodologies and models, and drive full adoption and utilization by the product and project engineering teams.
* Drive results and track effectiveness with performance metrics, targets, and outlook to drive continuous improvements for Automotive Engineering
* Cultivate and grow engineering excellence concepts into a mature state of work (processes, tools, capabilities) for implementation readiness.
* Collaborate with Automotive Services to leverage operating model initiatives to build software practices as a service.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or equivalent

* Hands-on and expert Knowledge and experience in Software development with Linux, Cloud Platforms (Azure preferred), and infra-automation such as Terraform, Docker Compose, GitOps, and shell scripting.
* Deep understanding of software development processes in the automotive industry including Continuous Delivery and virtual simulation.
* Experience in building up and maintaining a team of highly qualified experts
* Experience in defining, monitoring and acting on KPIs for driving improvements
* Experience in consulting with and advising a distributed global large-scale engineering organization
* Ability to articulate vision and influence decision making outcomes with internal stakeholders, external suppliers, and customers
* Radiates a mindset of continuous improvements of engineering execution methods and tools

* Prior experience in a strategy consulting firm with automotive customers

You bring an attacker's mindset and a security-first approach to every system you touch.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Blue team: detection & response (SIEM from scratch)**

* Design, deploy and operate our SIEM end to end: log sources, ingestion pipelines, parsing, retention, detection rules, alert routing and dashboards.
* Onboard logs from AWS (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow), Azure (Activity, Defender), Cloudflare, Google Workspace, Linux/Windows endpoints, firewalls and Kubernetes.
* Write and tune detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK; drive alert noise down and signal up.
* Own incident response: triage, containment, root cause, post-incident reviews and runbooks.

**Cloud & infrastructure security (AWS, Azure, on-prem)**

* Harden AWS and Azure accounts: IAM least privilege, SCPs/Azure Policy, network segmentation, KMS, secrets management, CSPM findings to closure.
* Secure on-prem device farms and data-centre infrastructure: Linux and Windows hardening (CIS benchmarks), patching cadence, EDR coverage, privileged access.
* Manage firewall policy and change control; review and tighten rules across cloud security groups and on-prem firewalls.
* Own Cloudflare: WAF rulesets, rate limiting, bot management, DDoS posture, DNS and TLS hygiene.

**Corporate & identity security (Google Workspace)**

* Administer Google Workspace security: SSO/SAML, MFA enforcement, OAuth app allow-listing, DLP, device policies, email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).
* Run joiner-mover-leaver access reviews and identity audits across SaaS.

**Pipeline & application security**

* Build security into CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning (Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks, Checkov or equivalent) with sane fail gates.
* Set up continuous public-facing scanning of our attack surface: asset discovery, exposed ports/services, certificate and DNS monitoring, misconfiguration alerts.
* Review architecture and code for security-sensitive changes; partner with engineering on fixes rather than throwing reports over the wall.

**Red team: VAPT, bug bounty & adversary simulation**

* Plan and execute internal VAPT on web apps, APIs, mobile, cloud and network; coordinate external pentests and drive remediation to closure.

* Hunt on our own platform the way an external researcher would; reproduce and weaponise findings to prove impact.
* Run purple-team exercises: emulate real attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) against production-like environments, then confirm the SIEM detects them and close the gaps it misses.

* Maintain security SOPs, baselines and runbooks; measure and report security posture to leadership.
